title: Eva Longoria-backed charity supports 100+ children at Vietnam orphanage, expands plans to Spain therapy centre
summary_full: Since 2018, the Global Gift Foundation has championed the Quang Chau Orphanage, now known as Casa Ángeles, providing care to over 100 needy children. This initiative, bolstered by funds from the Global Gift Gala in Paris, also supports the Casa Ángeles therapy centre in Spain. Through engaging performances and a vibrant auction, the event helps sustain vital projects aimed at uplifting vulnerable communities.
